Bluetooth Byte-Order

group BT_BYTE_ORDER

Bluetooth buffer/array byte-order utility macros.

Defines

INT_BIT_COUNT(integer, count)

{               \

count = 0;                                      \

while (integer)                                 \

{                                               \

count++;                                    \

integer &= integer - 1;                     \

}                                               \

}



Calculate integer bit count of b'1.

STREAM_SKIP_LEN(s, len)

{                   \

s += len;                                       \

}



Stream skip len.

STREAM_TO_ARRAY(a, s, len)

{                   \

uint32_t ii;                                    \

for (ii = 0; ii < len; ii++)                    \

{                                               \

*((uint8_t *)(a) + ii) = *s++;              \

}                                               \

}



Stream to array.

ARRAY_TO_STREAM(s, a, len)

{                   \

uint32_t ii;                                    \

for (ii = 0; ii < len; ii++)                    \

{                                               \

*s++ = *((uint8_t *)(a) + ii);              \

}                                               \

}



Array to stream.

LE_STREAM_TO_UINT8(u8, s)

{                   \

u8  = (uint8_t)(*s);                            \

s  += 1;                                        \

}



Little Endian stream to uint8.

LE_STREAM_TO_UINT16(u16, s)

{                   \

u16  = ((uint16_t)(*(s + 0)) << 0) +            \

((uint16_t)(*(s + 1)) << 8);             \

s   += 2;                                       \

}
